name: Veggie Pizza
description: A simple veggie pizza made with a crescent roll crust, cream cheese, ranch dressing, and various chopped vegetables.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup finely chopped green or red pepper

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Roll out crescent roll dough on a flat cookie sheet.
Bake until golden brown.
Mix cream cheese with ranch dressing.
Spread the cream cheese mixture onto the cooled crust.
Top with chopped vegetables.
Keep refrigerated before serving.
Cut with pizza cutter or knife.

keywords: veggie pizza, crescent roll crust, cream cheese, ranch dressing

_similar.name: Pizza
_similar.description: A homemade pizza recipe with a yeast-based crust, topped with spaghetti sauce, various meats, and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Dissolve yeast in warm water with sugar. Let stand in a warm place for 10 minutes.
Measure flour and salt into a large bowl. Make a well and pour in the yeast mixture. Stir and add oil gradually, working the dough until thoroughly mixed.
Knead the dough, form into a ball, and let stand in a warm place for approximately 45 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Roll out the dough on a floured pastry board to an even thickness. Transfer to a pizza pan or cookie sheet.
Cover with spaghetti sauce, meats, mushrooms, and other toppings. Finish with mozzarella cheese.
Bake for approximately 20 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Let stand for 3 to 5 minutes before cutting and serving.

_similar.name: Taco Ring
_similar.description: A savory taco-flavored ring made with crescent rolls, ground beef, and cheese, served with salsa and fresh toppings.

recipeInstructions.text: Fry the hamburger and let it cool.
Add ¼ cup water and taco seasoning mix to the fried hamburger.
Lay the crescent roll dough on the outside edge of a 15-inch pizza-style pan, forming a circle with the pointed edge out.
Scoop the hamburger mixture onto the dough, leaving a 5-inch wide circle in the center.
Add shredded cheese on top of the hamburger mixture.
Bring the pointed edge of the pastry over the beef mixture and press to seal.
Bake for approximately 16 minutes or as per the directions on the pastry package until golden brown.
Let cool slightly before serving.
To serve, remove the top from the green pepper and scoop out the insides. Place salsa inside the green pepper.
Place the green pepper in the middle of the ring along with shredded lettuce and tomato. Serve with sour cream.

_similar.keywords: taco ring, crescent roll recipe, taco bake, Mexican-inspired

_similar.name: Cabbage Rolls
_similar.description: Traditional cabbage rolls filled with a savory mixture of ground pork, beef, and rice, simmered in tomato juice.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the cabbage head for 10 minutes to soften the leaves. Drain and let cool.
Chop the onion and fry in lard for 10 minutes until softened.
Mix the cooked onion and lard with ground pork, ground beef, rice, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Peel off cabbage leaves and cut out the thick stem. Place about 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of each leaf, fold the sides, and roll into a neat package.
Line the bottom of a large pot with a layer of cabbage leaves to prevent burning.
Arrange the cabbage rolls seam-side down in the pot, layering them as needed.
Pour the tomato juice over the cabbage rolls, ensuring they are mostly covered.
Bring the tomato juice to a simmer, then reduce heat and let cook for the entire afternoon (approximately 3 hours).

_similar.keywords: cabbage rolls, stuffed cabbage, ground meat, comfort food

_similar.name: Bacon Broccoli Salad
_similar.description: A hearty broccoli salad with crispy bacon, red onion, and a tangy dressing featuring low-fat yogurt and feta cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the broccoli, red onion, sunflower seeds, raisins, and crumbled bacon in a large salad bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the yogurt, mayonnaise, sugar, and lemon juice to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss to coat.
Refrigerate for 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.

_similar.keywords: broccoli salad, bacon salad, yogurt dressing

_similar.name: Fairest Wheels
_similar.description: A chilled, rolled tortilla snack filled with a spicy chicken and cheese mixture.
recipeIngredient: ⅔ cup chopped green bell pepper
⅓ cup minced green onions and red pepper

recipeInstructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine chicken, lettuce, cheddar cheese.
In another bowl, beat cream cheese and sour cream together until smooth.
Add the cream cheese mixture to the chicken mixture and mix well.
Spread ⅓ cup of the chicken and cream cheese mixture onto one side of a tortilla, leaving a ½-inch border at the top.
Sprinkle with ⅓ cup shredded cheese and top with red pepper jelly.
Roll up the tortilla tightly and seal the edge.
Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling mixture.
Wrap each roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Trim the ends off each roll and cut into 8 slices.
Serve cold.

_similar.keywords: chicken roll-ups, cheese snack, cold appetizer
